question: what is this company worth, and what does the price already assume?

value_range.reading: Python did not compute a value range, so there is no low, base or high value per share to report, and I estimate none. The calculator's valuation entry prints its reason as "WACC is not computed: the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched". Its cost of capital entry prints "the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched". The inputs that need no price are present: a risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}, an equity risk premium of {cost_of_capital.equity_risk_premium|pct}, a pre-tax cost of debt of {cost_of_capital.pre_tax_cost_of_debt|pct} and a tax rate of {tax_rate|pct}. The beta, the cost of equity, the market value of equity, the weights and the discount rate are all absent, so none of my three scenarios was discounted. What can be read is how far apart my first-pass drivers stand and where they sit against the company's record. Year-one revenue growth runs from ten per cent in the bear through twenty in the base to twenty-six in the bull, against trailing-four-quarter growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} and a three-year compound rate of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct}. The year-ten operating margin runs from eight per cent through fourteen to nineteen, against a trailing margin of {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct} and a three-year average of {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct}. The base case therefore asks for growth under the present pace and for a long-run margin about level with the best full years on record, fiscal 2020 at {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.5.operating_margin|pct} and fiscal 2021 at {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.operating_margin|pct}. That is a reading of assumptions, not a value.

price_position.reading: The price cannot be placed: no price reached the calculator and there is no range to place it in. The calculator's market entry prints "no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched". The free-cash-flow yield cross-check is missing for the same reason, because both of its denominators need the market value of equity. The company's side of the comparison is in the file: a share count of {terms.shares_outstanding}, net debt of {ratios.solvency.net_debt} and trailing free cash flow to the firm of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm}. Without a price none of these says whether the market is paying for the bear, the base or the bull, and I do not infer it.

market_implied_growth.reading: No market-implied growth was computed, so I cannot say what the price already assumes. The calculator's implied growth entry prints "no reverse DCF: WACC is not computed: the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched". What stands ready for the comparison is the record and the guidance. Revenue compounded at {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct} over three fiscal years and {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct} over five, grew {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.revenue_growth|pct} in fiscal 2025, and is up {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} on a trailing-four-quarter basis. The release guides above all of these: "Raising revenue guidance for fiscal year 2026 to $6.3 billion plus or minus $100 million, a 32% increase YoY at the midpoint". My base case starts at twenty per cent, above the three-year compound rate and below both the trailing pace and the guided pace, and fades in a straight line to three per cent, below the five-year compound rate. A reverse DCF would have given the one constant ten-year rate at which that base case is worth the price; set beside the two compound rates, it would have shown whether the price counts on the present surge lasting. That number is not in this directory, and I do not supply one.
market_implied_growth.quote: Raising revenue guidance for fiscal year 2026 to $6.3 billion plus or minus $100 million, a 32% increase YoY at the midpoint

most_sensitive.reading: No sensitivity grid was computed, for the reason the valuation entry prints, so the effect of any assumption on value cannot be read off it. What can be read is where my three scenarios stand furthest apart against the record, and the year-ten operating margin is the widest: eight per cent in the bear, fourteen in the base, nineteen in the bull. The bear sits near fiscal 2023 at {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_margin|pct} and above the three-year average of {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct}. The base sits about level with the best full years, fiscal 2020 at {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.5.operating_margin|pct} and fiscal 2021 at {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.operating_margin|pct}. The bull sits above every full year on record. The latest quarter earned operating income of {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter} on revenue of {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}, a margin above any full year in the record and not yet held through one. Because this margin is the end point of the straight line that sets every forecast year and the terminal year, it is the first assumption a computed grid should test.

The second is year-one revenue growth, again read from the spread of my drivers and not from a grid. It runs from ten per cent in the bear through twenty in the base to twenty-six in the bull, and because Python fades each in a straight line to the terminal rate, the starting point carries into the revenue of every later year. The bear sits about level with the three-year compound rate of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct}, and the base sits close to fiscal 2025 at {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.revenue_growth|pct}. Even the bull is under trailing-four-quarter growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} and under the latest quarter's {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} on the year-ago quarter. The record shows how quickly this figure turns: growth of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.revenue_growth|pct} in fiscal 2023 was followed by {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.revenue_growth|pct} in fiscal 2024. Terminal growth differs less across my scenarios, since all three sit under the risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}, and its effect on value was not computed either.

accounting_adjustments.reading: There were none. The accounting analysis carries an empty list of adjustments, and with no valuation computed there is no value for an adjustment to have moved. Two of its findings still bear on how the drivers should be read. The calculator's tax rate is {tax_rate|pct}, which the accounting analysis ties to a share-award benefit that can reverse; after-tax operating income in every scenario would have been struck at that rate. The trailing change in trade working capital of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital} released cash that the company describes as timing, and my reinvestment rates do not carry that release forward. Free cash flow is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} on the simple measure and {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} on the quality-adjusted measure, the difference being share-based compensation and acquisition spending. That comparison is in the calculator, but it is not an adjustment to a computed value.

summary_ko.value_range: 주가 자료가 계산 파일에 들어오지 않아 베타와 자기자본비용, 가중평균자본비용이 계산되지 않았고, 그래서 주당 가치 범위도 산출되지 않았습니다. 가정만 놓고 보면 기본 시나리오는 첫해 성장률을 최근 네 분기 성장률 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}보다 낮게, 삼 년 연평균 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct}보다 높게 잡았습니다.
summary_ko.price_position: 기준일 주가가 없어 주가가 가치 범위의 어디에 놓이는지 판단할 수 없습니다. 주식 수 {terms.shares_outstanding}와 순차입금 {ratios.solvency.net_debt}는 파일에 있지만, 주가 없이는 시장이 어느 시나리오에 값을 치르고 있는지 알 수 없습니다.
summary_ko.market_implied_growth: 역산 현금흐름할인이 실행되지 않아 주가에 이미 반영된 성장률은 알 수 없습니다. 견주어 볼 회사의 기록은 삼 년 연평균 매출 성장률 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct}, 오 년 연평균 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct}, 최근 네 분기 성장률 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}입니다.
summary_ko.most_sensitive: 민감도 표가 계산되지 않아 어떤 가정이 가치를 가장 크게 움직이는지 수치로 확인할 수 없습니다. 세 시나리오가 가장 크게 갈리는 가정은 십 년 차 영업이익률과 첫해 매출 성장률이며, 회사 기록에서 영업이익률은 삼 년 평균 {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct}, 가장 좋았던 해 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.5.operating_margin|pct}였습니다.
summary_ko.accounting_adjustments: 회계 분석에서 넘어온 조정 항목이 없고 가치 자체가 계산되지 않았으므로, 조정이 가치를 움직인 금액은 없습니다. 다만 세후 영업이익에 적용될 세율 {tax_rate|pct}이 되돌려질 수 있는 주식보상 세금 효과에 기대고 있다는 점은 가정을 읽을 때 감안해야 합니다.

limits: This valuation is a set of stated assumptions run through a stated formula. It states no recommendation to trade, and a different reader choosing different drivers would reach a different value.
